speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Hello, how's your Labor Day going so far?

text: So far so good.  How are you?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I'm doing well, just finished dinner with the family so now it's back to Turking heh.

text: I guess so.  I just had a nice lunch myself.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Nice nice. Hey have you ever heard of the Save the Children foundation?

text: No, I haven't.  What is it?

text: Their an organization that provides aid and relief to children all over the globe.

text: What kind of relief do they provide?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: They help with food for kids that are starving, and medical aid to those that need it but can't afford it.

text: Nice.  How much of what they take in goes for salaries?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: The split ends up being 86% for the kids, 5% for fundraisers and the remaining 9% pay the salaries

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Do they provide any educational benefits for the kids?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: They do support a multitude of education programs in impoverished areas for the children. Hopefully with enough support they can do more and more for the suffering kids.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Do you know the cut-off age for assistance?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I don't have that information unfortunately, but I do want to let you know this HIT gives us an opportunity to donate a portion of our payment directly to the foundation, would you be interested in donating a portion of your payment to help the kids?

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: I might be willing to donate a very small amount.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: That's great, if you don't mind what amount would you donate? I like to match the donation with my partner on these hits when possible.

speaker: A2YTQDLACTLIBA
text: Oh, that's really nice of you to do that.  Give me a second to think.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I figure if enough of us give even just a small amount it can make a huge difference in the children's lives all around the globe.
